name: Divine Power Energy Ltd.
summary: Divine Power Energy Ltd. is an Indian electrical equipment manufacturer specializing in the production of insulated and bare copper and aluminum wires and strips. The company's product portfolio includes insulated wire, cable wire, and other insulated conductors, such as Paper Covered Copper/Aluminum Strips and Wires, Fiberglass Covered Copper/Aluminum Strips and Wires, and Super Enameled Copper Wires. These products are primarily utilized in the manufacturing of transformers and various electrical machinery. Divine Power Energy Ltd. primarily serves transformer manufacturers, power distribution companies, and sectors such as solar and automobile ancillary industries. The company supplies its components to both public and private sector enterprises in the power and distribution transformer industry. Its primary market is North India, including states like Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Uttarakhand, Haryana, Punjab, and Bihar.
